A '''turban''' was a kind of headwear. [[Svivreni]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] traditionally used a specific kind of turban and robes, which allowed them to be easily recognizable.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Dal Rogos]] usually dressed in a turban and clean [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] while undercover.<ref name="GA">{{WEGCite|story=Graveyard of Alderaan|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Two}}</ref>
